verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's docs explicitly describe escalation policies notifying a single target at a time until acknowledged, connecting services to users/schedules, and incidents escalating per policy — directly matching the delays/fallback-responder story. Community hands-on testimony corroborates the escalation behavior in practice (app notification, then call after a no-ack window). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 'repeat rounds' (looping back through the full policy again if still unacknowledged) and independent verification of fallback timing configurability beyond anecdote.
